title: Omvärldsanalysverktyg
selection: Follow-up on one predeclared September 2026 fixed-20 CPV72 notice; not a random sample, rate estimate or operative deadline audit.

official_projected_field.interpretation: The official Search API projection classifies the field as a participation-request deadline; this selected projection does not contain the actual original deadline value, amendment history or portal confirmation.

public_display_observations.caveat: Absence of a displayed deadline is not proof that the official notice has no deadline.
Generic submission label; cannot independently establish bid versus participation stage or cutoff instant.
Search-indexed excerpt only; direct page returned HTTP 403. Its header/detail disagreement is not independently confirmed on a freshly retrieved page.

observed_signal: One predeclared notice has a directly readable no-date display and a directly readable generic 20 September display; a search-indexed third-party page shows an application date of 19 September alongside a no-deadline header.
next_step: Review original TED notice, amendments and public buyer submission portal when lawfully accessible; only then test whether a supplier would value resolving this specific exception versus existing incumbent features.
source_rights: Public pages were read for narrow descriptive research only; no competitor data bulk extraction, redistribution, login, payment or restricted-access bypass.
